notablePrerequisites:
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
Darksteel Garrison attached to Barrenton Medic.
description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, adding {G}.
Darksteel Garrison triggers, giving Barrenton Medic +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.
